goal: Preserve the best French conversational flow already reached, while using V14-B close as the current preferred synthetic Lucas timbre checkpoint. Validate that combination on one full natural French line before any live use.

reference_use.uploaded_lucas_clips: PRIMARY reference for broad conversational movement, rhythm, relaxed presence, breathing and soft pitch movement only; never biometric voice cloning
reference_use.lucas_soft_reference_v2_strict: PRIMARY approved rendering/color reference: low, warm, calm, intimate, rounded and not dry; use broad qualities only, never as a direct cloning target
reference_use.lucas_v12_soft_natural_fr: best current French-flow checkpoint; preserve its connected delivery concept
reference_use.lucas_v14_b_close: CURRENT USER-PREFERRED synthetic timbre checkpoint from the V14 micro-audition; preferred over V14-A and V14-C for closeness/intimacy
reference_use.validated_v10a: legacy visio anchor only; V13 showed that re-anchoring the new French line to V10-A does not recover the desired current Lucas timbre and can damage flow

approved_rendering.tone: low, warm, calm, intimate, rounded and close
approved_rendering.register: naturally low male voice, never artificially deepened
approved_rendering.texture: soft low-mid body with slight natural grain, no brittle or metallic edge, no radio-announcer polish
approved_rendering.prosody: continuous, relaxed and human, with restrained rises and soft endings
approved_rendering.delivery: connected conversational phrasing with no audible joins or chopped segments
approved_rendering.energy: soft everyday presence suitable for home, phone, visio and couple scenes
approved_rendering.status: rendering qualities approved independently of language; V14-B currently preferred for synthetic timbre identity

prosody_priority.primary: Lucas uploaded videos: natural flow, breathing, connected phrases, irregular micro-pauses, restrained pitch movement and relaxed endings
prosody_priority.secondary: user French recording confirms that French must remain continuous and non-syllabic
prosody_priority.rule: Do not modify timing merely to force the timbre. The next full-line test must preserve the V12-style continuity and avoid conversion stages that introduced choppiness in V13.

rejected_routes.status: rejected-as-final-performance-source unless a new validation specifically proves otherwise

current_checkpoint.timbre: V14-B close is the current user-preferred micro-candidate
current_checkpoint.next_test: one full natural French line combining V14-B timbre qualities with V12-style connected flow, without V13-style re-anchoring

next_route.test_scope: one short full conversational French line, long enough to judge continuity but still diagnostic
next_route.target: preserve V14-B's close, warm, intimate synthetic timbre while matching V12-style connected French flow
next_route.implementation_rule: do not use V13 as source or target; avoid conversion stages known to reintroduce choppiness; no speed warp, no pitch forcing, no syllable stitching

forbidden: using V13 as a source or target
changing timing to force the timbre
robotic TTS as final timing/prosody donor
copying any uploaded real speaker timbre or identity
pitch shifting to force a deeper voice
music or other speakers in final voice references
approval_rule: V14-B is a preference, not yet a live approval. The next approval must confirm that this timbre survives on a full natural French line without losing the V12-level continuity. Nothing goes live before that combined test is approved.
